interest: Tokyo trial defense sought an International Court of Justice opinion.
keywords: International Military Tribunal for the Far East
overview: Commander Coleman, Tokyo trials defense chief, asks Marjorie M. Whiteman (October 19, 1948) about referring legal questions to the ICJ.

people.name: Beverly M. Coleman
people.role: Chief of Defense Counsel in the Tokyo Trials for War Criminals; Commander, U.S. Navy

people.name: Marjorie M. Whiteman
people.role: Legal Adviser's Office, Department of State

people.name: George O. Gray
people.role: Official, Department of State (Office of the Legal Adviser)

people.name: Douglas MacArthur
people.role: General of the Army; Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers

subfiles.about: Memorandum detailing a conference between Commander Coleman and Miss Whiteman regarding the feasibility of referring legal questions from the Tokyo war crimes trials to the International Court of Justice.
subfiles.summary: Commander Coleman asks Marjorie M. Whiteman whether Tokyo trial law could go to the International Court of Justice before MacArthur's review; she explains only states or UN organs can seek rulings.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversation on Possible Reference of Questions of Law Involved in Tokyo Trials to the International Court of Justice
